assign.argument: destination container in rdi, source container in rsi

builder.reference: open PR #2409 pins the string builder semantics; referenced, not re-claimed

container.slot18_rule: last node of the root's +0x10 walk
container.slot20_rule: last node of the root's +0x18 walk

leftover.advance: +0x10 successor loaded before the node's own deletes

node.raw38_note: never read or written by this component

orphan.example: old root whose first child has siblings A -> B -> C, assigned a single-node source: B is reused, A and the root are destroyed, C is orphaned
orphan.mechanism: a simple-case pop clears the new pool head's +0x10 link and a splice-case pop clears the spliced node's +0x18 link; a node reachable only through a cleared link is neither reused nor destroyed

pool.entry_rule: old +0x20 node's +0x10 successor when it exists, else the old +0x20 node itself

pop.nxt_null: pool[1] becomes nxt (0) and pool[0] is cleared
pop.splice: nxt's +0x18 is cleared, pool[1] walks from nxt's next down its +0x18 chain to the deepest node, then to that node's +0x10 successor when one exists

rebuilder.arguments: source node in rdi, link in rsi, pool in rdx

splice_example: old root R with only child X, assigned a two-node source: the first pop splices (R.child cleared, pool[1] becomes R) and the second pop takes R itself, so both old nodes are reused and none is deleted

string_rule.inline_when: stored pointer equals the address of its own capacity/inline slot (+0x30)
string_rule.rebuild: the single string, from the source pointer and length
string_rule.reuse_dispose: the old string is disposed before rebuilding
